text_simplified: Parents must guide their children towards salah and good akhlaq, and warn them against bad companions, forbidden places, and harmful music and songs. They should also choose righteous companionship, as it greatly influences the child’s tarbiyah and behavior.

review_defects.why: The Islamic term 'suhbah' is translated instead of transliterated, while other terms in the same document ('salah', 'akhlaq', 'tarbiyah') are transliterated. This is inconsistent transliteration.
The Arabic title says 'الأخلاق' (morals/character) without the adjective 'حسنة' (good). The English adds 'Good', which is not present in the Arabic title.
